scope_note: Confirms the current signed-in account, adopts only its already-authorized network memberships, and invalidates online peers' catalog and directory. Does not create a network membership, select a network, rewrite device identity, or delete a pair. Live local coordination is source-level evidence only, not physical Mac-Windows or overnight ICE acceptance.

state_matrix.test: reads the account and its directory at shell start

field_bindings.field: confirmed selected account, WSS registration and existing network adoption
field_bindings.source: the persisted account token, the exact original mTLS device identity and the coordinator's authoritative membership response
field_bindings.assertion: successful login required a separate manual network refresh before the remote computer appeared
field_bindings.missing_semantics: A current-user confirmation fails on WSS/adoption/read refusal; it never guesses an account or network and never reports a catalog that was not read back.

field_bindings.field: online peer registration invalidates pair catalog and refreshes device directory
field_bindings.source: a validated coordinator peer-registration event after exact current-account and selected-session checks
field_bindings.assertion: registration did not read current pair authority and invalidate the choice view
field_bindings.missing_semantics: Foreign, self, stale-session or malformed registration cannot change the local catalog; a failed authoritative read stays a logged failure and does not synthesize rows.

field_bindings.field: forwarded peer-registration event after manager validation and state application
field_bindings.source: the authenticated control-v2 coordinator subscription bound to this server epoch
field_bindings.assertion: accepted coordinator registration did not schedule catalog/directory convergence
field_bindings.missing_semantics: The helper callback receives only validated events and cannot block the signalling receive loop.

field_bindings.field: PeerRegistration callback capability on the real manager
field_bindings.source: explicit manager configuration owned by the restored device account
field_bindings.assertion: accepted coordinator registration was not forwarded unchanged
field_bindings.missing_semantics: No unvalidated or rewritten identity event is passed to the account refresh owner.

field_bindings.field: confirmed login automatically starts account-session synchronization
field_bindings.source: the successful login result followed by the exact current-user read through the typed management bridge
field_bindings.test: confirms login automatically before loading networks, without manual refresh
field_bindings.missing_semantics: The signed-in identity renders immediately; synchronization is started without requiring a refresh or network re-selection, and a read failure is not presented as signed out.

field_bindings.field: active service network choices reload on catalog invalidation without changing the user's saved choice
field_bindings.source: the typed main-process catalog-change event and subsequent authoritative networkChoices read
field_bindings.test: refreshes choices for the active service when another device invalidates the catalog
field_bindings.missing_semantics: Events for another service are ignored; refresh reads choices only and never chooses or mutates a network.

field_bindings.field: open add-tab menu owns the network-choice invalidation subscription lifecycle
field_bindings.source: the existing typed catalog event API for the exact selected coordinator
field_bindings.test: lists a computer paired elsewhere while the menu stays open
field_bindings.missing_semantics: While open, an online peer's catalog push updates the list; unmount releases the subscription and no extra runtime tab is created by refresh.

real_commands.command: npm run environment:check && npm run format:check && npm run architecture:check && npm run type-check

cd networking && test -n "${DSHKER_SERVER_BINARY:?build the independent production coordinator first}" && GOWORK=off DSHKER_SERVER_BINARY="$DSHKER_SERVER_BINARY" go test -json -race ./integration -run '^TestNetworkAdoptionNotifiesOnlinePeerManager$' -count=1 -timeout=90s > ../.run/login-network-convergence/real-coordinator-client-push.jsonl
npm run service:smoke && npm run visual:smoke && npm run build && npm run build:electron
